sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

But, as you'd expect from a game of this caliber, the mechanics are more complex than they initially seem. Each fidget toy has its unique characteristics, such as speed, accuracy, and difficulty level, which affect how quickly you can progress through the game.

          As you play, you'll earn coins and rewards, which can be used to buy new fidget toys, upgrade existing ones, or access special features like power-ups and bonuses. The game also features a 'store' where you can purchase in-game items, such as boosters, to aid your progress.

          One of the standout features of 'Pop it 3D Fidget' is its use of a 'combo system', where clicking on multiple fidget toys in quick succession can trigger massive rewards and combo multipliers. This adds a level of strategy to the game, as players must weigh the risks and rewards of going for high-score combos versus simply playing for fun and relaxation.

          The game also features a 'leaderboard' where you can compete with other players to reach the top spot, adding a competitive element to the game that's perfect for players who enjoy a challenge.
